raw.thought:
Drafting a regex for Indian mobile numbers with optional +91 or 0 prefix and 10 digits starting with 6-9. Will provide three matching test strings and two non-matching ones.

The regex `^(?:\+91|0)?[6-9]\d{9}$` is ready. It handles 10-digit numbers with or without the +91 or 0 prefix.

Confirmed that 9-digit numbers and those starting with 5 will not match. The regex does not allow spaces after the prefix.
